html:
<form role="search" (submit)="submit($event)">
  <input
    class="cs-input"
    type="search"
    [value]="value() ?? ''"
    [placeholder]="placeholder()"
    [disabled]="disabled()"
    (input)="change($event)"
    (blur)="markTouched()"
  />
  @if (value()) {
    <button csButton="ghost" type="button" (click)="clear()">{{ strings.strings.clear }}</button>
  }
</form>
